suppression.rule: No minimum sample-size threshold is applied to the selected non-party attitude maps; valid response counts are always displayed.

method: Unweighted pooled respondent counts, following the existing report method. All-waves results pool available waves; they are not an average of locations or a national estimate.
coordinate_method: Central coordinates from respondent_locations.csv; points identify named survey locations and are not respondent coordinates.
data_source_method: Location aggregates are built in one pass from the longitudinal Waves 1-7 workbook. Wave row totals are reconciled against the independently validated separate-wave files.
